verifications.claim: Rec Room has over 150 million users
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'reaching over 150 million players and creators'; R2: '150 million users'; R3: 'more than 150 million players'; R4: 'more than 150 million players'; R5: 'more than 150 million players and creators'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Rec Room reached over or more than 150 million users/players/creators.

verifications.claim: Rec Room will shut down on June 1, 2026
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Rec Room will be closing down on June 1st 2026'; R2: 'shutting down operations on June 1st'; R3: 'shutting down on June 1'; R4: 'shut down on June 1'; R5: 'shutting down on June 1st'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm shutdown on June 1 (R1 specifies 2026 explicitly, others in same context).

verifications.claim: Rec Room could not make the platform sustainable
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'we never quite figured out how to make Rec Room a sustainably profitable business'; R4: 'could not find a path to profitability'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly quote or paraphrase Rec Room's admission of failing to achieve sustainability.

verifications.claim: Rec Room's expenses consistently exceeded revenue
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue we brought in'; R2: 'our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue'; R3: 'Our costs always ended up overwhelming the revenue'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quotes from sources confirm costs consistently exceeded revenue.

verifications.claim: Rec Room laid off half its staff in August 2025
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'cut roughly half its remaining workforce five months later [after March 2025], eliminating 141 positions'; R5: 'laid off half of its staff in August'
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly states August layoffs of half staff; R4 confirms timing and scale (five months after March 2025 = August).

verifications.claim: Rec Room's August 2025 layoffs followed previous layoffs
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'laid off 16% of its staff in March 2025 and then cut roughly half its remaining workforce five months later'
verifications.reasoning: R4 explicitly states August layoffs (five months after March) followed previous layoffs.

verifications.claim: Snap Inc. has acquired some assets from Rec Room Inc.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Snap Inc. confirmed ... that it has acquired select assets from Rec Room Inc.'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly confirms Snap Inc. acquired select assets from Rec Room Inc.

verifications.claim: Some Rec Room staff are joining Snap Inc. to work on its Specs AR hardware initiatives
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Some of Rec Room’s employees will be joining Snap ... to support its Specs eyewear and augmented reality initiatives'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states Rec Room employees joining Snap for Specs AR initiatives.

verifications.claim: Rec Room has officially announced that all token purchases and $-denominated offers are disabled
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'On May 1st: You will no longer be able to purchase tokens or any $-denominated offers'
verifications.reasoning: R1 is the official announcement stating token purchases and $-offers will no longer be available (effectively disabled as of May 1st); minor tense difference but directly supported.
